newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine's Kuchma optimistic on Yeltsin visit.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine's Kuchma optimistic on Yeltsin visit.

text.p: President Leonid Kuchma said on Wednesday he was optimistic Russian President Boris Yeltsin would make a scheduled trip to Ukraine this month which has been cancelled six times since Kiev won independence in 1991.

"We have every reason to be optimistic. I think Boris Yeltsin personally has a will to come but I do not rule out that some forces think differently. Look at the Russian media," Kuchma told a news conference held with visiting Polish President Alexander Kwasniewski.
